# logmoji

> Small emoji logger for Node.js. Each log line gets an emoji and a level label, with log levels, minimum-level and allowlist filtering, ANSI colors, timestamps and context loggers.

Install with `npm install logmoji`. The package exports a factory, not a logger: call `require("logmoji")({ timestamp: false })` in CommonJS, or `import createLogger from "logmoji"` and then `createLogger(options)` in ESM. Set `LOGMOJI_DISABLE=true` in the environment to silence all output.

## Docs

- [Home](https://halitsever.github.io/logmoji/): overview
- [Usage](https://halitsever.github.io/logmoji/usage.html): install, every log function, context loggers and level filtering
- [Configuration](https://halitsever.github.io/logmoji/config.html): timestamps, date formats, minLevel, levels, custom emojis and colors
